caption: : Eval PPL. under different Sub-Dim Numbers settings.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between "Numbers of Sub-Dims" and "Eval PPL." The x-axis is labeled "Numbers of Sub-Dims" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 64 to 256, with tick labels at every 64 increments. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and uses a linear scale ranging from 9.5 to 12.5. A blue line with circle markers and a solid line style traces values starting at approximately 10.0 at x=64 and reaching approximately 10.9 at x=256. A red dashed line with no markers starts at approximately 11.9 at x=64 and remains approximately constant at 11.9 across the entire x-axis range.
